# Australian Accounting Skills

> Fifty agent skills for Australian public-practice, tax and contracting-business
> preparation, packaged as a Claude Code plugin marketplace and as portable
> SKILL.md files. Each skill states its inputs, its evidence and tie-out checks,
> and the decisions it hands to a person.

Preparation only, and not advice. The skills never lodge, file, submit,
transmit, declare, pay or finalise anything with the Australian Taxation Office
or any other agency, and they give no tax, legal, financial or assurance
conclusion. An authorised human reviews, decides and lodges. Rates, thresholds,
BAS labels and due dates are verified at a primary source at use time, never
recalled from memory. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Australian
Taxation Office.

## Install

- Claude Code plugin marketplace, delivering the 50 skills on `main`:
  `/plugin marketplace add ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills` then
  `/plugin install australian-accounting-skills@ryanduguid`
- Codex plugin, the same revision:
  `codex plugin marketplace add ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills` then
  `codex plugin add australian-accounting-skills@ryanduguid`
- Any agent that reads SKILL.md, via the skills CLI:
  `npx skills add ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills`
- The 19 workflows in the v0.2.1 release: clone that tag and install the
  checkout, as [docs/installation.md](docs/installation.md) sets out.
